reviews.text: I’ve taken my miniature poodle to Nisa for grooming several times and she always does such a wonderful job! Highly recommend!

Staff was very helpful in showing me how to use everything in the self-wash area.  This is perfect for me as I just can't stoop over in the bathtub anymore.  Everything was easy to use and within reach so I never left my pup's side.  First time visit, and I even bought a membership.

Alberto is the best in trimming dogs nails and handles dogs professionally ,my dogs are troublesome but for Alberto its no problem,the prices are a good value and the place is nice with a big parking lot and nice lobby.
Thanks for taking the time to leave a rating! We'd love to know more about your visit so we can do better. Feel free to reach out to us directly — we're always here and happy to chat.
Easy and all the tools you need to clean the pups
Very clean. And cheap
Friendly and efficient, thank you!
I love Petbar Oak Forest!! My frenchie is always so well taken care of here, the groomers and staff are so kind and patient. I highly recommend this location to any pet parent.
Good and cheap

The self wash is very convenient but a bit expensive. Unfortunately had to cancel my membership after 3 months. I always came at 5:30 when I got off work. Now all of a sudden self wash’s ends at 5pm and was turned away. When are working people supposed to come lol?
Great place if u wanna save money and do a good job yourself

I had a wonderful experience at Petbar! They were fast, gentle, and very careful while trimming my dog’s nails. The technicians were patient and did an excellent job, making the entire process stress-free.

One of my favorite features is that they have cameras in each grooming room, so you can watch everything on a TV monitor from the waiting area. It gave me so much peace of mind being able to see exactly how my dog was being treated.

I highly recommend Petbar to anyone looking for caring, professional service. We’ll definitely be back!
Staff was so very helpful! I hadn’t been in a while and forgot how the self wash worked. The gentlemen took his time to guide me through it again. My pup is all fresh and clean!
nice and clean good service
Very friendly staff and clean facility. I took my rescue dog here for her first wash. It’s so much more convenient than trying to wash at home.

We have two pretty particular dogs. The entire staff is great, but Alberto goes ABOVE and BEYOND to help them feel at ease.

He is truly awesome.
This place makes it so easy to bathe your dog, and the staff is always very helpful.  We always have them trim and grind our dog’s nails.   Today Alberto did it, and he was great with our dog!

I have been having the dogs nails trimmed here for over a year. Albert is great. Last time he was off and I let the lady that greeted me grind his nails. I informed her that Sam has arthritis and hip discomfort (he is getting old). She twisted his back leg to the point of him yelping. He limped on that leg for a week. I went in today to have 2 dogs nails trimmed and asked for Alfred. The same lady that was rough with Sam said that there was not anyone named Alfred there (his name is Albert) and seemed put out that i asked for someone besides her. (BTW, Sam is 96 pounds of muscle and the new rescue is over 100 pounds), I need someone that can handle big dogs (Albert does great).

We’ve been bringing our dogs to Joel for years, and we couldn’t be happier with the care they receive. He’s an excellent groomer who is patient, professional, and always does an amazing job. When he moved to this new location, we gladly followed because we trust him completely. Our dogs always come home looking great and are treated with kindness and care. If you’re looking for a groomer who truly loves what he does and takes care of your pets, we highly recommend Joel.

Petbar is awesome!  It is sheding season and
I did a self-wash and a long blow out.  Took out tons of undercoat and Willa looks awesome.
First time to use their services and i wasn't disappointed! Great staff and my puppy was clean and happy! I will def go back for monthly service. Thanks Petbar! You Rock!
Excellent, speedy, affordable

Our little guy looked great and happy! We got there at our appointment time and he had a full grooming session, including full body trim. He was done in about an hour and a half; which I really appreciated him not being in a crate for hours and the groomer’s skill really showed!

This was our first time using this service. It was well worth it! Our pup smells good, her fur is soooo soft, and no shedding when we pet her. Her breath smells great too after the toothbrushing. Will be getting the membership.
We appreciate the 5 stars, Omar! It means a lot to our team and we’re so glad you enjoyed your visit. Thanks for choosing petbar — we look forward to welcoming you back!
Took my very shy frenchie in for his first spa day. He did great and his stank is gone! Staff was super friendly. Got the membership bc it just makes sense.
Enjoyed using the self wash. Everything was so clean and the staff was excellent and helpful. Will be coming back!!

Thank you so much for the 5-star review Fabiola! We’re thrilled you had a great experience at petbar and truly appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback. We can’t wait to see you and your pup again soon!
This dog groomer is fantastic! My dogs both have high maintenance fur and they did such a great job with the grooms! They are happy pups! Thank you Petbar!

This is the best neighborhood spot for an awesome bath and blow dry for your dog! We took our girl raider today and the staff was incredible with her! She was nervous and a little skeptical but the staff did a fantastic job making her feel comfortable and made the process so smooth. She came out smelling amazing and all fluffed out! They were so efficient and even got her nailed clipped without her even noticing! Facility was very clean and minimal noise level which was great! Would definitely go back and love that they have a self service bath station that is super affordable! Thanks again pet bar!!!
